preflight.operatorBaselineDescription: quiet Auto, full-brightness static green, no red/sleep, HyperBoost inactive; USB and 12 V connected

sequenceEvidenceLimit: The successful typed supervisor result retains stage permits and completed payloads, matching-work-token cancellation observation, disposal outcomes and actual exit codes. Reviewed source establishes the fixed eight logical exchanges and completion-receipt gates. This is not an independently sniffed native packet trace or packet count.

productionAdmission.reason: One attended hardware trial observed cancellation of a developer-armed idle wait with the matching work token between HID operations, followed by full disposal and actual child exit4. A fresh post-exit physical Medium confirmation preceded the second process opening. The supervisor retained original raw0000 while the fresh query returned raw0300; Auto physically returned to quiet baseline with green lighting unchanged, then raw0000 was restored. This establishes only the tested idle-wait cancellation boundary, not production work-loop cancellation, in-flight native-I/O cancellation, crash safety, independent fan-state/RPM readback, ownership, vendor handback or production support.

limitations: The hash and length identify a private typed supervisor result, not PCAP or an independently retained native report trace.

Hardware was exercised in this attended trial, but the canceled work was only a developer-armed idle wait between completed HID operations. Production work-loop cancellation and in-flight native-I/O cancellation were not tested.

The first child fully disposed its actor and returned exit4 after matching-token cooperative cancellation. No crash, forced termination, USB interruption, sleep, power loss or vendor handback was tested.

Medium and Quiet Auto are attended operator observations. No exact RPM or independent firmware fan-state or ownership readback was obtained. Raw0000 and raw0300 retain accessory-only unassigned semantics.

Matching completion receipts, observed cancellation and actual-exit ordering are established by the successful supervisor result together with reviewed source. Sanitized stage receipts preserve outcomes without publishing authentication secrets or operating-system process identifiers.

Operator record timestamps are journal-save bookkeeping and may follow supervisor completion; they are not YES submission timestamps. The typed result proves baseline, fixed, post-cancellation, Auto and final physical confirmations were accepted during the command.
No Synapse, service action, power cycle, retry or recovery occurred during this trial. ManualPowerCycleOnly records the command recovery acknowledgement; it does not establish that recovery happened.
Private paths, process identifiers, nonces, serials, device-instance suffixes, module identifiers and raw native reports are excluded. BIOS is provenance only and imposes no admission gate.
